claims.value: Carved emaciated male figure with pendant ears, moai kavakava, made of hard light brown wood (Thespesia populnea) with eyes of bone; on the head is carved a bird-like beast in low relief.
Height: 43 centimetres Weight: 500 grammes Width: 9 centimetres Depth: 9.50 centimetres
Identified as Thespesia populnea by Caroline Cartwright (BM Conservation and Scientific Research), March 2010.
